content.title: About
content.content: Nutritional powder mix Muscle Milk is a ready‑to‑drink protein supplement containing high‑quality whey and casein proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins and minerals. It is designed to support muscle growth, post‑workout recovery and provide the body with essential nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Muscle Milk was first launched in the early 2000s as an alternative to dairy‑based protein shakes.
The blend includes both fast‑acting whey and slow‑digesting casein proteins for prolonged amino‑acid delivery.
Formulations often add L‑glutamine and creatine to accelerate recovery.
Available in a variety of flavors such as chocolate, vanilla, strawberry, and more.
Widely used by athletes and active individuals for quick protein and calorie replenishment.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: One serving provides about 20‑25 g of protein, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Complete amino‑acid profile
items.content: Contains all essential amino acids, including BCAAs, crucial for muscle protein synthesis.

items.title: Energy support
items.content: Maltodextrin carbohydrates quickly replenish glycogen stores after intense exercise.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: Includes B‑vitamins, vitamin D, calcium and magnesium to aid metabolism and bone health.

items.title: Convenient to use
items.content: Powder dissolves easily in water, milk, or plant‑based drinks, delivering a nutritious shake in seconds.

items.title: Milk‑protein allergy
items.content: Contains whey and casein, which may trigger reactions in individuals allergic to dairy.

items.title: Added sugars in some flavors
items.content: Certain variants contain added sugar, which may be unsuitable for diabetics or low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Digestive discomfort
items.content: Lactose or artificial sweeteners can cause bloating or upset stomach in sensitive people.

items.title: Calorie excess
items.content: Regular consumption without accounting for total daily calories can lead to weight gain.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix 30‑40 g of powder (about one scoop) with 250‑300 ml of water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage, shaking or blending until smooth. Recommended post‑workout or as a snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry powder in a tightly sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, use within 3‑6 months. Discard if it develops an off‑odor or discoloration.
